allow: PowerShell($body = '{"archetypeKey":"sage","scores":{"sage":12,"builder":5,"creator":4,"connector":3,"hunter":2},"language":"en","plan":"advanced"}'; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3001/api/report/dev-generate" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -TimeoutSec 60; Write-Host "SUCCESS - content length: $\($response.content.Length\) chars"; Write-Host "First 300 chars:"; Write-Host $response.content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(300, $response.content.Length\)\))
